content.comment_body: Hello, I need some help. I have a [product_name] with [version_no], and when I attempt to connect, it shows a small program and requests an LSC password. Since I purchased this device used, I don't know the password. How can I erase the existing program and upload my own?
You can use the Reset Tool to restore the [product_name] [version_no] to its factory settings. Please note: you will need an SD card formatted with FAT32 and a maximum capacity of 32 GB.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is unable to access a used [product_name] [version_no] because it asks for an LSC password they do not have, making it difficult to clear the existing program and add a new one. Another user recommends using a Reset Tool and gives SD card requirements. Common usability issues include restricted access due to password protection and unclear reset steps for those without prior experience.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes for a straightforward method to reset the device without requiring the previous owner's password, making it easy to start with a clean slate and upload their own program.
